hero.description: I guide you through building resilient brands and designing data-led marketing plans that create measurable results.

about.title: A Journey of Expertise and Passion
about.imageAlt: Maryam's journey of expertise and passion
about.paragraph1: My professional journey began in 2013, where I refined my skills in leading companies across integrated fields including identity design, digital marketing, and search engine optimization (SEO).
about.paragraph2Start: Over those years, I closely witnessed what makes brands rise, and why they stumble despite having resources. In 2019, I crowned that experience by founding
about.paragraph3Start: Over time, I realized that ambitious business owners are not looking for just an execution agency. They need a
about.paragraph3End: who understands their vision and guides them honestly toward the right path.
about.highlight: That is why today I offer marketing consulting with an approach built on simplicity, transparency, and practical methodology.

items.title: Strategic Consulting Sessions
items.desc: We analyze your project reality, identify gaps, and draw an actionable plan that enables you to lead your team or work with execution partners with full clarity.

items.title: Brand Building and Foundation
items.desc: We design an identity that reflects your values and reaches your target audience with precision. The journey starts with market research and ends with a complete visual and strategic brand launch.

items.title: Marketing Audit and Performance Review
items.desc: A comprehensive review of your current efforts, with practical recommendations to improve the sales funnel and raise marketing productivity.

philosophy.title: My Work Philosophy
philosophy.subtitle: Clarity Before Execution
philosophy.body: I believe in complete clarity and staying away from verbal complexity. My goal is not to create more marketing noise, but to direct effort toward channels that deliver real return.
philosophy.problemBody: We face it with transparency and complete honesty to reach the most suitable solution.
philosophy.opportunityBody: We seize it through an organized methodology that ensures the highest possible value.
philosophy.closing: The goal is not more work, but more precise achievement.
